ai_summary: For Q1 FY27, 20 Microns Limited reported a slight 1.0% YoY revenue decline to ₹2447.2 million amidst subdued demand and global uncertainties. Despite external cost headwinds, the company achieved improved profitability, with EBITDA increasing by 2.1% YoY and margins expanding to 13.2%, attributed to a favorable product mix and disciplined cost management. Looking ahead, a significant ₹100 crore capacity expansion program is planned to drive future growth, market share, and enhance specialty product contributions.
